en: This is a vintage postcard depicting a street scene in an old European city. The image shows a gently sloping street with grand multi-story buildings on either side, people walking along the sidewalks, and a set of stairs leading up to an elevated area with trees. The image is sepia-toned, typical of early 20th-century photography. There is a round purple stamp with the text 'BIBLIOTECA PUBLICA PONTEVEDRA' at the top, and printed text at the bottom identifies the scene as 'Vigo. - Calle de Carral.'
